Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

18th August 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang called General Lu, Deputy Military Governor, stationed at Woosung, to the Arsenal yesterday, and told him that he had instructions from the Central Government that 1,500 of General Lu's troops who are stationed near the Arsenal should return to Woosung. General Lu replied that he had already heard news of the proposed transfer through the soldiers concerned who are unwilling to leave the Arsenal until they are given a gratuity of several months' pay.
There are at present a number of General Lu's troops stationed in Olapoi. A report has lately become current among those that they will be transferred to the North, but they say that they will not leave Shanghai whatever happens. They also say that they are entitled to a gratuity for the way they have maintained the peace in Shanghai, and are threatening that they will join the Manchu Restoration Party if they do not get it.

An office has been opened at No. 155 Avenue Joffre to collect information regarding revolutionaries who were executed in Shanghai in order to make arrangements with the Government to compensate their families.

A bomb explosion occurred in No. 5 Ching You Li, 慶安里 an alleyway in Frenchtown, at 1.20 p.m. 17th inst. The house in question was occupied by six natives of Honan, who belong to the Kuomintang party and who ran away after the explosion. It is thought that they were making bombs when the explosion took place for the French Police found eight unexploded bombs in the house when they visited it soon afterwards.

Your obedient servant,

Munin Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年8月18日。

先生：

据报，杨将军昨日召见驻防吴淞的副督军卢将军至兵工厂，并告知他，奉中央政府指令，卢将军驻防在兵工厂附近的1,500名士兵应返回吴淞。卢将军回复称，他已通过相关士兵获悉拟议调动的消息，这些士兵表示在获得数月薪饷作为犒赏之前，不愿离开兵工厂。

目前，卢将军的部分部队驻扎在奥拉波伊（Olapoi，音译）。最近在这些士兵中流传着他们将被调往北方的消息，但他们声称无论发生何种情况都不会离开上海。他们还表示，鉴于他们在上海维持治安有功，有权获得犒赏，并威胁称若得不到犒赏，将加入满清复辟党。

已在霞飞路155号设立一处办事处，收集关于在上海被处决的革命党人的信息，以便与政府安排对其家属的抚恤事宜。

本月17日下午1时20分，法租界庆安里5号发生一起炸弹爆炸事件。该房屋由六名河南籍人士居住，他们属于国民党，爆炸后逃逸。据信爆炸发生时他们正在制造炸弹，因为法国巡捕随后不久前往该处搜查时，在屋内发现了八枚未爆炸的炸弹。

您的顺从仆人，

Munin Armstrong
总探长。

警务处总监上尉。

Shanghai Municipal Council.
17th August 1916.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
Sir,
It is reported that a secret society known as
Pah Jion Yoh Zon Wen 八旗育才會 has its headquarters
in Hongkow and another secret society entitled Man
Mung Li Yih Won 滿蒙聯合會 has its headquarters in
Wayside district. It is believed that these secret
societies have been formed to support the work of the
Manchu Restoration party. It is reported that the
promoters of them are living in a Japanese Hotel.
General Yang has received instructions from
Peking to keep in touch with the doings of Secret
Societies in Shanghai.
Your obedient servant,
mmmmmustang
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
1916年8月17日。
（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探科））
警务处，
（侦探科。）
先生：

据报，一个名为“八旗育才会”（Pah Jion Yoh Zon Wen）的秘密社团将其总部设在虹口，另一个名为“满蒙联合会”（Man Mung Li Yih Won）的秘密社团将其总部设在越界筑路区（Wayside district）。据信，这些秘密社团的成立是为了支持满清复辟党的活动。据报，其发起人居于一家日本旅馆内。

杨将军已收到来自北京的指令，要求其与上海各秘密社团的动向保持联系。

您的顺从仆人，

mmmmmustang
总探长。

警务处总监上尉。
